10001.name: Motion timeout
10001.remedy: Check servo drive power and cabling
10001.cause: Mechanical jam, speed/accel too low for the timeout, drive lost enable mid-move

10002.name: Axis not homed
10002.cause: Machine just restarted, after E-Stop or after clearing a drive fault without homing

10003.name: Axis emergency stop
10003.remedy: Release E-Stop and reset the axis

10004.name: Following error
10004.remedy: Check mechanical load and servo tuning
10004.cause: Overload or jam, servo gain not tuned, speed/accel beyond motor capability

10005.name: Soft limit exceeded
10005.remedy: Check target position and soft limit config
10005.cause: Taught/recipe point outside the allowed range, wrong unit entered, soft limits configured too narrow

10006.name: Hard limit hit
10006.cause: Axis over-travel, limit sensor dirty or misaligned, taught point too close to the end

10007.name: Axis driver fault
10007.remedy: Check servo drive fault code and power
10007.cause: Overload, overheat, encoder fault, motor power phase loss — read the code on the drive

10008.name: Motion connection lost
10008.remedy: Check motion card cabling and power
10008.cause: Broken/loose EtherCAT or USB cable, motion card not powered, card driver conflict on the PC

20001.name: Image grab failed
20001.cause: Loose GigE cable, insufficient network bandwidth (packet size), trigger not reaching the camera

20002.name: Vision tool failed
20002.cause: Part far off the trained pattern, lighting changed, vision job not trained or wrong version

20004.name: Vision timeout
20004.remedy: Check processing load and camera link
20004.cause: Tool too heavy, PC overloaded, waiting for an image whose trigger never fired

20005.name: Camera connection lost
20005.cause: Camera cable/power lost, IP changed, camera held by another program

30001.name: Part missing
30001.remedy: Check part feeding and position sensor
30001.cause: Tray empty, slow feeding, part-present sensor misaligned or dirty

30002.name: Clamp failed
30002.remedy: Check air valve and clamp sensor
30002.cause: Low air pressure, worn cylinder/gripper, cylinder reed switch misaligned

30003.name: Sensor fault
30003.cause: Dirty/misaligned sensor, broken wire, noise — compare the sensor LED with the IO screen

30004.name: I/O connection lost
30004.remedy: Check I/O module cabling and power
30004.cause: IO network cable broken, IO module lost power, IP changed

30006.name: Analog value out of safe range
30006.remedy: Check the channel's air supply/sensor and the safe range in analog.map.json
30006.cause: Air leak, worn/blocked nozzle, faulty pressure sensor, recipe thresholds not suited to the product

10009.name: Z-axis brake released
10009.remedy: Engage the brake in the Manual Operation screen before running

40013.name: Config file modified outside the app
40013.remedy: Check Settings → Machine settings → Config integrity; re-sign if the change was intentional

40014.name: Collision-protection rule file invalid
40014.remedy: Fix move-protection.json per the log error and restart — NO collision rules are active

40001.name: Database error
40001.remedy: Check database file/service and disk space

40002.name: Critical system error
40002.remedy: Review system log and restart application

40003.name: Invalid configuration
40003.remedy: Check config file and parameter values

40004.name: License expired
40004.remedy: Contact vendor to renew the license

40005.name: System init failed
40005.remedy: Review init log and check hardware

40010.name: Repeated failed logins
40010.remedy: Check who is operating the machine — account is NOT locked, warning only

40011.name: Service login (day-code)
40011.remedy: Confirm OEM engineer is servicing; review audit log; log out when done

40012.name: Break-glass recovery file armed
40012.remedy: Confirm the admin recovery was intentional; change admin password afterwards

50001.name: Connection failed
50001.remedy: Check network cable and device address
50001.cause: Device off, wrong IP/port, firewall blocking, loose network cable

50002.name: Communication timeout
50002.cause: Device slow or hung, network congested, configured timeout too short

50004.name: Protocol error
50004.remedy: Check protocol configuration on both ends

50010.name: Modbus exception
50010.remedy: Check register address and PLC access rights

50011.name: Modbus slave no response
50011.remedy: Check slave ID and bus wiring
50011.cause: Wrong slave ID, broken RS-485 wire, wrong baud/parity, missing termination resistor

50021.name: Serial buffer overflow
50021.remedy: Lower send rate or read more frequently

50030.name: TCP socket error
50030.remedy: Check network connection and device state

50040.name: OPC UA bad quality
50040.remedy: Check tag status and OPC server

50050.name: EtherNet/IP tag not found
50050.remedy: Check tag name in the PLC

50051.name: EtherNet/IP type mismatch
50051.remedy: Check tag data type on both ends

60003.name: Batch full
60003.remedy: Close current batch and open a new one

60004.name: NG limit reached
60004.remedy: Investigate defect cause and reset counter
60004.cause: Material lot change, worn nozzle/tool, vision calibration drift — check the NG Pareto by reason

60005.name: Sequence invalid
60005.remedy: Fix the sequence JSON per errors in log, then Initialize again

60006.name: Sequence aborted
60006.remedy: Check the failing step in the log, resolve, then Reset and restart

70001.name: Emergency stop
70001.cause: E-Stop pressed, safety circuit open, safety relay not reset

70002.name: Safety door open
70002.cause: Door opened while running, door switch misaligned or faulty

70003.name: Light curtain broken
70003.remedy: Clear obstruction from light curtain and reset
70003.cause: Person or object crossed the curtain, curtain dirty or optically misaligned

70004.name: Interlock breach
70004.remedy: Check safety chain and confirm reset
70004.cause: Command issued while an interlock condition is not met (door, air pressure, axis not in safe position)

70010.name: Outputs still forced
70010.remedy: Open I/O Monitor and release all forced outputs before running

70011.name: Collision rule blocked motion
70011.remedy: Read the reason on the banner; move the related axis to a safe position (e.g. raise Z) and retry

70012.name: Collision rule disabled
70012.remedy: Re-enable the rule as soon as recovery is done; rules re-enable automatically on user change or restart
